nodes.title: Video size Note
widgets_values:
Set your video Size.

By default its set to 560x720 with Upscale by 2. That results in a 1120x1440 video! Default upscale method is "lanczos"!

Feel free to change anything it to fit your own specs.

nodes.title: CFG Note
widgets_values:
-Set you seed, Steps and CFG

-Seed: If your are not having luck with your results, try changing the seed.

-Steps: More steps means better quality but longer generation time. Its set as "4" by defult. Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use even numbers! 

-CFG: More CFG means better results but lognger generation time. Its set as "1.0" by default. 
1.0 is needed for speed-up's like 4/8-step models/LoRAs

Fell free to change it and test new configurations. Use values between "1" and "1.5".


(1 disables/ignores the negative prompt!)
